info.name: Surexoglobal API (Website + Admin — PHP & MySQL)
info.description:
Complete Postman v2.1 collection for Surexoglobal Website & Admin Portal PHP + MySQL REST API.

Base URL defaults to Live (`https://ttbilling.in/surexoglobal/api`). Switch `base_url` variable to `http://localhost/surexoglobal/api` for local testing.

Note: PUT, PATCH, and DELETE requests use cPanel-safe POST + `?_method=...` & `X-HTTP-Method-Override` headers (native HTTP verbs are also supported by the PHP API).
